objective: Replace Marites fullscreen arrow navigation with deliberate left/right swipes while preserving gallery paging, zoom, reactions and playback controls; open regular Android/web Wall videos fullscreen on video tap instead of a dedicated square.
productionBaselineEvidence: Verified GitHub main source SHA 63ccd4b58ff02ff3c1535a1e05d3097fa8323c61 and isolated branch ancestry only. No claim of active production OTA, Android build, runtime or on-device verification.
chosenApproach: Track bubbled single-touch swipe start/end on the Marites modal, reject small/vertical/slow/multitouch gestures, and defer to photo carousel until an edge. Use one testable pure decision helper. Reuse existing CommunityVideo fullscreen callbacks and saved playback position on native, keyboard accessible HTML5 video click on web. Keep IMA ad player controls unchanged to preserve ad clicks.
selectionRationale: No dependency or backend changes, no new player lifecycle and no extra decoder allocations. Guarded gesture detection preserves multi-photo image interactions and user reaction picker while removing floating arrows.
alternativeApproaches: Overlay full-screen tap capture on ad videos (rejected: would intercept monetized ad clicks).
Force horizontal pan recognizer to own multi-photo scroll (rejected: would break existing pinch and gallery paging).
Reuse native HTML5 controls on inline web player (rejected: controls would consume tap instead of opening fullscreen).
acceptanceChecks: Left/right swipe between stories only for intentional horizontal gestures; header/footer buttons and reaction picker remain usable.
Photo gallery swipes within photos until the first/last edge; pinch-to-zoom disables story step.
Marites fullscreen viewer no longer renders previous/next arrows or old arrow hint.
Normal Android Wall video frame tap opens fullscreen at saved playback position; fullscreen tap still plays/pauses, controls remain accessible.
Web video frame click or Enter/Space opens fullscreen, where HTML5 seek/play controls remain available.
IMA ad click behavior, audio, poster, cache, retry and offscreen playback are unchanged.
Exact HEAD release gates and Android smoke verification are required before any OTA; no production publish from this branch.
preserveBehaviors: User-owned Marites stories, local and shared 72h feed, comments, privacy, reactions and music.
Native video preload/autoplay, sound toggle, playback continuation, poster loading, buffering and retry.
AdMob and IMA monetization click-through and visibility protections.
Current production runtime, security, database schema and release identity; no OTA publish.
